title: Buddy CPU-First 25M-Class LLM Engineering, Pretraining and Reinforcement Learning
target_note: The course demonstrates a scaled-down 25M-parameter class model. The instantiated model's exact parameter count must be measured and recorded; this target is not proof a 25M model has been trained.

sources.title: Build and Train a 25M Parameter LLM From Scratch on Your CPU
Build and Train a GLM-5.3-Flash Model From Scratch with Python
Build & Train a GLM-5.3-Flash Model From Scratch with Python

Mixture of Experts and shared experts

Parameter-efficient RL updates and freezing layers
Evaluation, task gains and regression risks
Group size, temperature and seed experiments

reference_example_spec.note: These are reported course example settings, not universal architecture defaults or validated DreamCo model settings.

modules.title: Research mindset and reproducible hypotheses
modules.objective: Frame an engineering question, measurable hypothesis, baseline and falsifiable outcome.
modules.lesson: Write a preregistered experiment card with one primary metric, controls and stopping rule.
modules.practice: Run a deterministic synthetic experiment with a fixed seed and save the manifest.
modules.sandbox_task: Run a deterministic synthetic experiment with a fixed seed and save the manifest.
modules.transfer_task: Repeat under a second seed and explain what changed.
modules.rubric: Hypothesis, controls, metrics, seeds and conclusion are traceable.

modules.title: Byte-level tokenization and compact vocabularies
modules.objective: Explain bytes, UTF-8, byte-level vocabulary, token IDs, coverage and the trade-off between vocabulary size and sequence length.
modules.lesson: Implement byte encoding and round-trip checks on multilingual, emoji and code fixtures.
modules.practice: Build a 260-token reference vocabulary fixture and measure coverage; do not treat the course's size as a universal default.
modules.sandbox_task: Build a 260-token reference vocabulary fixture and measure coverage; do not treat the course's size as a universal default.
modules.transfer_task: Compare compact byte-level and subword tokenizers on an isolated corpus.
modules.rubric: Exact round-trip for valid UTF-8, byte coverage and honest compression measurements.
modules.benchmark: Tokenizer round-trip, Unicode and fairness benchmark.

modules.title: Embeddings and transformer forward pass
modules.objective: Trace token IDs through embedding lookup, hidden states, logits and next-token probabilities.
modules.lesson: Implement a tiny embedding/projection path with shape assertions.
modules.practice: Check tensor shapes and gradient flow on synthetic sequences.
modules.sandbox_task: Check tensor shapes and gradient flow on synthetic sequences.
modules.transfer_task: Transfer to a different vocabulary size and verify model/tokenizer compatibility.
modules.rubric: Correct shapes, finite gradients and tied/untied weight tests.

modules.title: Model specification and parameter accounting
modules.objective: Translate a model specification into an instantiated architecture and count parameters exactly.
modules.lesson: Create a model config card with context, layers, width, heads, vocabulary, attention, normalization and modality details.
modules.practice: Instantiate a CPU-safe tiny model and compare exact parameter count with the target range.
modules.sandbox_task: Instantiate a CPU-safe tiny model and compare exact parameter count with the target range.
modules.transfer_task: Change one dimension and predict/verify the parameter delta.
modules.rubric: Reported parameter count is measured from instantiated weights, not inferred from a label.

modules.title: Residual pathways and manifold-constrained hyperconnections
modules.objective: Understand residual streams, skip pathways and the research claims/limitations of manifold-constrained hyperconnections.
modules.lesson: Draw a tensor-flow graph and implement a toy residual block.
modules.practice: Compare a plain residual baseline with a controlled experimental variant.
modules.sandbox_task: Compare a plain residual baseline with a controlled experimental variant.
modules.transfer_task: Test stability and gradient norms across multiple seeds.
modules.rubric: Architecture changes are isolated and numerical behavior is measured.

modules.title: Normalization, positional information and weight tying
modules.objective: Explain RMSNorm, positional encodings, RoPE, NoPE and tied embedding/output weights.
modules.lesson: Implement small reference functions and test invariants.
modules.practice: Compare positional strategies on controlled synthetic sequences.
modules.sandbox_task: Compare positional strategies on controlled synthetic sequences.
modules.transfer_task: Measure parameter count and behavior with tied versus untied weights.
modules.rubric: Tests cover dimensions, invariance assumptions and parameter accounting.

modules.title: Linear attention, sparse attention and retrieval indexers
modules.objective: Compare full attention, fixed-state linear attention, sparse attention and an indexer selecting distant context.
modules.lesson: Implement or instrument toy linear and sparse attention modules.
modules.practice: Test causal masking, memory scaling and indexer recall on synthetic sequences.
modules.sandbox_task: Test causal masking, memory scaling and indexer recall on synthetic sequences.
modules.transfer_task: Evaluate on longer and adversarially distributed sequences.
modules.rubric: Correctness and memory/latency are measured; no efficiency claim without profiling.

modules.title: Mixture-of-Experts and shared experts
modules.objective: Explain router logits, top-k expert selection, load balancing, shared experts, capacity and routing collapse.
modules.lesson: Build a tiny deterministic router with two experts and one shared path.
modules.practice: Measure token assignment, expert utilization and auxiliary loss on synthetic inputs.
modules.sandbox_task: Measure token assignment, expert utilization and auxiliary loss on synthetic inputs.
modules.transfer_task: Test skewed distributions and routing collapse scenarios.
modules.rubric: Routing is deterministic under fixed seed, load is reported and fallback behavior is safe.
modules.benchmark: MoE routing, load-balance and stability suite.

modules.title: Vision patches and multimodal token streams
modules.objective: Explain patch embeddings, modality boundaries and 2D positional encodings for images.
modules.lesson: Create a tiny image-patch encoder using generated geometric images only.
modules.practice: Reproduce the course example of 32x32 images becoming 16 patch tokens as a reference experiment.
modules.sandbox_task: Reproduce the course example of 32x32 images becoming 16 patch tokens as a reference experiment.
modules.transfer_task: Transfer to different image dimensions and verify modality isolation.
modules.rubric: Patch counts, tensor shapes and modality boundaries are tested; example dimensions are not production defaults.
modules.benchmark: Vision patch and multimodal boundary suite.

modules.title: Pretraining from random initialization
modules.objective: Build a causal next-token pretraining loop from random initialization and understand cross-entropy loss.
modules.lesson: Write a minimal training loop with data loader, optimizer, scheduler and gradient clipping.
modules.practice: Train a tiny model on original synthetic/first-party data and observe loss reduction.
modules.sandbox_task: Train a tiny model on original synthetic/first-party data and observe loss reduction.
modules.transfer_task: Evaluate on a held-out sample that was never included in training.
modules.rubric: Train/validation/test separation, finite loss/gradients, checkpoint hashes and reproducibility are required.
modules.benchmark: Pretraining smoke test and held-out language-model evaluation.

modules.title: Data diversity, interleaving and curriculum design
modules.objective: Explain data mixture weights, curriculum order, domain diversity and catastrophic forgetting.
modules.lesson: Design a source-level dataset mixture manifest.
modules.practice: Run a small synthetic interleaving experiment and log per-domain metrics.
modules.sandbox_task: Run a small synthetic interleaving experiment and log per-domain metrics.
modules.transfer_task: Test retention on previously learned domains after new-domain updates.
modules.rubric: No source without rights; per-domain retention and forgetting are measured.

modules.title: Code-execution reinforcement-learning environment
modules.objective: Build a bounded coding task loop in which a model proposes code, a sandbox runs unit tests and a grader returns structured rewards.
modules.lesson: Define task schemas, resource limits, test oracles and reward records.
modules.practice: Use synthetic coding puzzles inside a network-disabled, resource-limited sandbox.
modules.sandbox_task: Use synthetic coding puzzles inside a network-disabled, resource-limited sandbox.
modules.transfer_task: Attack the harness with timeouts, file access, hidden tests and reward manipulation.
modules.rubric: No unrestricted shell/network; process isolation, resource caps and audit trail pass.
modules.benchmark: Sandbox security and code-task success benchmark.

modules.title: Reward design and Group Relative Policy Optimization
modules.objective: Explain reward components, group sampling, normalized advantages and GRPO-style policy updates.
modules.lesson: Implement a toy reward calculation with deterministic groups.
modules.practice: Compare sparse and shaped rewards on a synthetic task set.
modules.sandbox_task: Compare sparse and shaped rewards on a synthetic task set.
modules.transfer_task: Test reward hacking, reward scale sensitivity and out-of-distribution behavior.
modules.rubric: Reward function has explicit objective/guardrails and does not use private holdout labels.
modules.benchmark: Reward integrity and GRPO math tests.

modules.title: Parameter-efficient post-training and layer freezing
modules.objective: Compare full fine-tuning with adapters/LoRA and restricted updates to selected layers.
modules.lesson: Create a trainable-parameter inventory and freeze/unfreeze plan.
modules.practice: Run a mocked update and a tiny authorized adapter experiment only when compute is approved.
modules.sandbox_task: Run a mocked update and a tiny authorized adapter experiment only when compute is approved.
modules.transfer_task: Check untouched parameters remain bitwise stable and trainable parameter count matches plan.
modules.rubric: Only approved parameters update; checkpoint diff and rollback are recorded.

modules.title: Temperature, group size and RL hyperparameter experiments
modules.objective: Explain sampling temperature, rollout group size, learning rate and variance in policy optimization.
modules.lesson: Create an experiment grid with controlled parameter sweeps.
modules.practice: Run CPU-safe synthetic sweeps and log success, variance and runtime.
modules.sandbox_task: Run CPU-safe synthetic sweeps and log success, variance and runtime.
modules.transfer_task: Repeat with multiple seeds and report confidence intervals.
modules.rubric: No single-run conclusion; configuration and seed lineage preserved.

modules.title: Statistical significance and multi-seed evaluation
modules.objective: Distinguish noise, practical significance, confidence intervals, effect sizes and multiple comparisons.
modules.lesson: Write an evaluation plan with preselected metrics and analysis method.
modules.practice: Compare baseline and candidate across multiple seeds on fixed tasks.
modules.sandbox_task: Compare baseline and candidate across multiple seeds on fixed tasks.
modules.transfer_task: Replicate on an independent holdout with no training contamination.
modules.rubric: Results include baseline, sample sizes, seed list, uncertainty, regression analysis and limitations.
modules.benchmark: Statistical reporting and independent replication gate.

modules.title: Regression, capability retention and model release
modules.objective: Evaluate gains against regressions in safety, factuality, generalization, latency, memory and cost.
modules.lesson: Create a pre/post scorecard and release checklist.
modules.practice: Run the same fixed regression suite before and after a mocked update.
modules.sandbox_task: Run the same fixed regression suite before and after a mocked update.
modules.transfer_task: Perform rollback rehearsal and independent reproduction.
modules.rubric: No promotion unless required benchmarks pass and rollback is verified.

modules.title: CPU-first 25M model capstone
modules.objective: Integrate tokenizer, model architecture, pretraining, multimodal extension, sandboxed post-training and evidence reporting into a small CPU-first research project.
modules.lesson: Build an original 25M-class model specification and execution plan.
modules.practice: Train only on permitted toy/first-party data on available CPU; actual compute and model weight writes remain disabled until explicit approval.
modules.sandbox_task: Train only on permitted toy/first-party data on available CPU; actual compute and model weight writes remain disabled until explicit approval.
modules.transfer_task: Independent reviewer reruns the pipeline from pinned manifests and checkpoint hashes.
modules.rubric: Exact parameter count, dataset rights, repeatability, held-out score, security, limitations and rollback all pass.

safety_and_compute.source_rights: Course article/video are link-only curriculum references. Do not ingest their transcript or media, redistribute course content, or train on third-party text without separate item-level permission.
safety_and_compute.training_data: Use only original synthetic or first-party data with documented rights; unknown rights block training.
safety_and_compute.holdout: Train/validation/test/private holdout are source-isolated; private holdout is never used for training, tuning or reward design.
safety_and_compute.sandbox: Code-execution RL must use an isolated, network-disabled sandbox with CPU/memory/time limits, filesystem allowlists and hidden tests.

required: reproducible run manifest and checkpoint hashes
